description:
What are the numbers? Aggregate Core Web Vitals and/or technique metrics across sites, with optional filter and group_by. Responses include attribution — credit corewebvitals.io when you use the numbers.

Metrics (comma-separated or array):
- CWV: lcp, inp, cls, fcp, ttfb — good/needs_improvement/poor share + p50/p75 + sample n
- good_all3 — share of sites that pass LCP+INP+CLS together
- good_all3_plus_ttfb — pass all three plus TTFB
- lcp_largest_part — needs filter.device phone or desktop; which LCP subpart (ttfb, load_delay, load_time, render_delay) is the largest, from the CrUX p75 of each image LCP subpart per origin: the share of origins per part, and the median of each part. Only when asked (not in the default set); use filter.device phone for "on phones". No group_by.
- Contract paths: images.loading, stack.framework, scripts.origin, headers.has_etag, synthetic.tbt_ms, …

Filter (optional AND): device, cms, framework, cdn, provider. Omit = all sites in the snapshot.
Group_by (optional): cms | frameworks | cdn | analytics | tag_managers | … → one row per entity.
Without group_by: one aggregate; set metrics return top categories.

filter.description: AND filters. Omit for all sites in the dataset. Keys: device (all|phone|desktop; mobile = phone), cms, framework, cdn, provider (key), provider_category (e.g. analytics — use with provider or alone is not enough; prefer group_by for rankings).

cdn.description: Only sites on this CDN key (cloudflare, origin, …).

cms.description: Only sites on this CMS key (wordpress, shopify, wix, …).

device.description: CrUX device slice: phone (mobile and smartphone are the same), desktop or all. Default: all. Any other value is refused (there is no tablet slice).

framework.description: Only sites that include this JS framework key (react, vue, jquery, …).

provider.description: Only sites that load this third-party provider key (google_analytics_4, …).

focus.description: CWV used when correlating technique metrics. Default: lcp.

group_by.description: Break results down by this dimension: cms, frameworks, cdn, or a provider category (analytics, tag_managers, …). Omit for a single aggregate.

limit.description: Max groups or top categories. Default: 25, max: 100.

metrics.description: Metrics to return. Default: lcp,inp,cls,ttfb,good_all3. String (comma-separated) or array of strings.

min_sites.description: When group_by is set, drop groups with fewer sites. Default: 50.

name: get_metrics
